quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Independent director Yu Wei (results briefing): Q1 2026 revenue was RMB 12,992.87 ten-thousand, up 37.81% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 447.96 ten-thousand; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB -1,156.79 ten-thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue RMB 12,992.87 ten-thousand (+37.81%); net profit RMB 447.96 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Min Dayong (results briefing): in optical communication, yield is the key driver of gross margin - margins are held back by yield today but profitability will improve with yield gains and scale production, and he expects the optical-communication chip business's gross margin to keep improving in 2026. With a full optical-communication product matrix (EML, DFB, VCSEL, PIN, PD), some optical-communication revenue already in 2025 and optical chips in shortage across the market, the company is fairly optimistic about its 2026 optical-communication business; asked about expansion, he said it will prudently assess capacity additions against customer demand and industry trends. In 2026 it will focus on its main business, consolidate its position in high-power laser chips and serve leading customers, optimising its product mix as industrial-laser customers consolidate.

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Min Dayong (results briefing): Everbright has laid out silicon photonics integration, which it calls an important route for next-generation high-speed optical communication, through Suzhou Xingyao Photonics Technology, set up by a wholly owned subsidiary; on its line-construction schedule the process line is expected to be connected by the end of 2026 and to enter formal production in 2027. The company also said its phase II plant is in interior fit-out as planned and not yet in production.
quarterly_data.figure: silicon photonics process line by end of 2026; formal production in 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Everbright Photonics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Min Dayong (results briefing): the company multi-sources key raw materials; it has long-standing relationships with the main domestic and overseas indium phosphide (InP) substrate suppliers and its purchasing team monitors substrate purchases and inventory, so substrate supply is secure and stable and will not affect the business.
